name: 11752 · Islip Terrace, NY
findings: ZIP 11752 (Islip Terrace) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11752 (Islip Terrace) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11752 (Islip Terrace) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
